board.title: Unmet demand
board.intro: Searches over the last thirty days that found nobody. It is what families asked for and could not get — supply intelligence you cannot obtain anywhere else, and information this platform would otherwise have discarded.
board.windowNote: Fixed thirty-day window. It cannot be widened or narrowed, because two overlapping windows subtract to a single family's search.
board.suppressedWhy: A group is shown only once at least three separate searches share it. Below that, a count could identify the household that made it.
board.empty: Nothing unmet in the last thirty days.
board.emptyBody: Either every search found a tutor, or the groups that did not are each below the threshold at which a count can safely be published.
board.noIdentity: These are counts. No family, student or contact is recorded against them, and none can be reached from here.
board.topics: Topics named by at least three of them

reason.insufficient_information: The intake could not narrow it down

board.filterNote: Filters choose which groups to show. They never split one, so a filter cannot be used to get beneath the threshold.

post.heading: Nobody matched this search
post.body: Post it to the unmet demand board. Tutors read the board when deciding what to offer, and a subject nobody teaches in your area is exactly what they are looking for.
post.privacy: Only the subject, level, board, area, gender preference and a budget band are recorded. Nothing identifies you, and no tutor can reply to it — this is a count, not a request.
post.done: Posted. Thank you — it is now one entry in the count for your area.
post.failed: That did not post. Nothing was recorded.
